subject: WATCH: Socialist protester blames 'provocateurs' after assaults near RNC convention in Dallas
posts:
When street clashes break out, the blame game begins instantly.
Evidence: Protester blame, Police arrests, Counter-assault claims
#Aletheia #Dallas #Protests

Protesters claim peaceful assembly was disrupted by right-wing provocateurs and heavy-handed police tactics.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

Police confirmed arrests followed physical assaults on counter-protesters and illegal road obstruction outside the RNC convention.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.8, -0.85) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Blaming provocateurs for direct physical altercations obscures accountability and fuels polarization.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 12.5, z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Protester Narrative: FAIL (-0.85, -0.9) — Shifts blame for assaults onto imaginary agitators.
- Police Response: COND (0.0, -0.2) — Enforces order amid high-tension political friction.
Dallas police in riot gear arrested two demonstrators near the RNC midterm convention after confrontations and alleged assaults against counter-protesters.

The Bright Side:
Public security was maintained without requiring major medical intervention for the minor injuries reported.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing political grievance (WHO is protesting) with criminal actions (WHAT laws were broken during the clash).

Social Physics Analysis:
Protesters deployed a Smart Selfish Maneuver by using a noble anti-agenda pretext to mask aggressive confrontations, then projected blame onto right-wing provocateurs when police intervened.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Pretexts replace accountability, locking participants into mutual hostility.

The Unavoidable Truth: Political demonstrations frequently attract fringe elements looking for direct physical confrontation.

The Unavoidable Lie: Peaceful intent always shields violent actors from individual legal responsibility.

Alethekanon:
Actors invert responsibility by projecting their own aggressive tactics onto phantom provocateurs to shield their movement.

Awwthekanon:
It is heartbreaking to see passionate civic energy curdle into street violence and mutual suspicion when communities deserve genuine dialogue.

Brothekanon:
Classic playbook: start a fight near the barricades, get cuffed, and immediately scream that someone else forced your hand.

Spirithekanon:
"He who troubles his own house will inherit the wind" Proverbs 11:29 FAIL
Those who sow internal strife and project blame onto external agents ultimately consume their own community's peace.
